Use case: production animation keypose family matching APPROVED Nerra of Tidewheel Citadel. Image1 is existing productionbody/claws, Image2 approvedcharacterreference. Exact SAME Nerra character: glossy coral/oxblood marine crab with barnacles, ruined greycastle towers and smallredflags growing from spiralshell, short expressive teal-iris stalkeyes, creamunderjaw, blackpearljoints and eight SHORT walkinglegs. No humanarm/torso, no othercreatures. Premium dimensional wet-shell / roughstone / agedsteel3Dmaterials exactlymatch.
Create exactly SIX independent objects on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA in TWO ROWS THREE COLUMNS, about2048square, very generous clear gutters, no text, labels, celldividers, UI, scenery or shadows. Orthographic shallow front-threequarter camera facing slightlyright as source. Complete unclipped silhouettes. Four bodyposes share EXACT same camera, body scale, proportions, castle layout, lighting, fixed support-foot baseline and visible shoulder-ball sockets. NO huge frontclaws on body poses; those animate independently.
ROW1COL1 BODY IDLE: body/shell with all8shortlegs, planted stable, narrowed smug eyes and smallconfidentmouth, exactlyoriginalidentity.
ROW1COL2 BODY LATERAL STEP: samebody, centre of torso still centred and foot baselinefixed, left-side legs visibly lifted and bent for a short physical sideways step, right-sidelegs supportweight, eyesfocusinmovementdirection; little torso weightshift, no size change or reversedcamera.
ROW1COL3 BODY HIT-STUNNED: samebody, body crouches slightly, severallegs bend towardground but keepgroundcontact, face with large dazzled pupils/creasedeyebrows and open gasp mouth. REAL readable facialexpression, no icons, stars or floating comicmarks. No detached armour.
ROW2COL1 BODY ANGRY CHAIN-PULL: samebody, rearlegs brace and forelegs flex, torso leansback slightly for force, BOTH front shoulder-ball sockets clearly exposed, fierce downturnedbrows, intenseeyes and clenched/openangrymouth. No chain or hugefrontclaws baked into thisbody.
ROW2COL2 RIGHT GATE CLAW CLAMPING CHAIN: isolated matching narrower coral/agedsteel rightpincer + shortjointedarm, actual exposed rear shoulderball at upperleft as in source, hugeclawcurvesdownright. Clawjaws are CLOSED FIRMLY around TWO OR THREE real darksilver interlockingchainlinks, with the lowest shortchainlink hanging down fromgrip. Chain visiblycaught BETWEEN jaws, no chain piercingopaquejaw, no wheel/gate/bodybaked. Preserve oldrightclawidentity, shortarm, not a humanhand. Wholeclaw/chainisolatedwithcleartruealpha.
ROW2COL3 VERTICAL CHAIN SEGMENT: seven connected interlocking heavy aged-steel links with slightalternatingdepth, same metalas claw-heldchain andapprovedwheel. Straight vertical, clean top/bottom half-linkanchors for code tiling/routeplacement, truealpha insideeachlinkhole. No glow, rope, neon line, background, wall or UI.
The purpose is truly articulated physical chainpull: independentbody, separate grippingclaw, actualmetalchainrun. No sideways genericclone, no broadcontinuousbeam. Retain every face/leg/flagwithin itsowncell with largegaps; last source too tightlypacked, so at least5%cleartransparentmarginaroundeachobject. Sourcequality must survive200worldu body on phone. Treat fourposes as consistent keyframes, not fourdifferentcrabs.
framingRepair: Precise production-framing repair of supplied six-object sprite sheet. Preserve ALL six subjects EXACTLY: four Nerra bodyposes/expressions, the rightclaw holding realchain, and metalchainstrip. Preserve characterdesign, camera, materials, shell/castlelayout and facialexpressions. REARRANGE into TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, neverthreecolumns: row1 idlebody / stepbody; row2 hit-stunnedbody / angrypullbody; row3 chain-grippingclaw / verticalchainstrip. Eachcell must contain one complete object with at least15% cleartransparentmargin on every side and broad invisible gutters. The previous sheet clips body legs at imageleft/right and crowds adjacent bodies. Restore COMPLETE missingouterleg/clawtips, no cutoff. Bodies must ALL have SAME SCALE based on identicalshell/castle/faceproportions; angrypullbody must not be25% larger thanidle. Supportfootbaseline consistent within theircells. Preserve bodyposes as the exactsamecharacter, don'tswap idle/step/hurt/angryfaces. The pincerclosesonrealchainwithjawgripclear; chainstripverticalcomplete. True TRANSPARENT RGBA, emptybackground and emptygutters. No labels, dividers, UI, floor/shadow or text. This is ONLY a deterministicframing/normalization repair, no newcharacterdesign, no newscene.
